quintBinding.name: Beryl MBT Adapter
quintBinding.driverGuidanceMarkdown:
- Implement a Beryl adapter for every replayable QNT/MBT branch set.
- Dispatch by the observed QNT action name and fail on unknown action names.
- Project Beryl state into the exact comparison shape named by the QNT driver.
quintBinding.reproductionMarkdown: Use `BERYL_TRACE_SEED=<seed>` to reproduce a failing Beryl MBT Adapter run and `BERYL_TRACE_LOG=verbose` when trace details are needed.
